value.rationale: An exact infinite-family integer homology classification for arbitrary unequal complete multipartite graphs with t>=4 is mathematically motivated by resilience and natural simplicial topology. Constructive dual homotopy wedge yields three or more distinct nonzero degrees and a new binomial first-homology invariant. Neither old balanced-tripartite nor unrelated total-visibility statements imply these results.
